items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: Carney used to play with us when we went up for the summer in Salem, Willows, he played with us.

ctx.x: As you got ready to go?

No. Harry Carney never become a full-fledged member of our band until we went to the Cotton Club, he never. Carney and Johnny Hodges, they never -- we enlarged the band. Carney used to play with us when we went up for the summer in Salem, Willows, he played with us. We gave him a job, he was justa little kid. We just gave him a job, but when we went to the Kentucky Club, of course, we went up to New England for Sy Clarit Schribman and that's when Carney joined us up there.
What kind of a gig was that, in Salem?
